question: Where is restaurant situated within 10 kilometers along the travel path toward Paintball Jungle, American Canyon, CA from the View Lounge, San Francisco, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%View Lounge%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Paintball Jungle%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%American Canyon%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_path_buffer AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry)::geography, 10000) AS buffered_geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, travel_path_buffer tpb WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, tpb.buffered_geom::geography);
